convergence_policy.trigger: ConvergenceWarning or iteration cap reached; never validation performance
convergence_policy.retry: fresh estimator, identical seed, data, C, loss, penalty and dual selection
convergence_policy.second_failure: block; never omit candidate or relax tolerance
convergence_policy.legacy_reuse: checksum-verified converged fits only; preserve actual producer/parameters
